messages:
Jo: Heads up 12h PTO left from this year, policy 8h carryover max. My manager Sam is traveling. Can someone confirm options?
Sam: I'm on a red-eye but can approve a standard 8h carryover. For the extra 4h the usual options are payout or lose it; exceptions need form.
Jo: Prefer payout. What's the exact admin flow so payroll doesn't miss cutoff?
Olivia (People Ops): Hi! Flow: 1) Manager approval recorded in BambooHR, 2) Employee files CE form linking to manager approval, 3) Payroll bot needs the CE ID in thread before cutoff. Cutoff is 2026-01-04 23:59 PST.
Jo: Ok I'll submit once Sam confirms in BambooHR. Sam, can you record approval?
Sam: Done 12025-12-30 22:05 UTC. I approved 8h carryover + payout 4h.
BambooHR Bot: Manager approval logged: Sam approved carryover 8h + payout 4h for Jo at 2025-12-30T22:05:00Z.
Jo: Submitted CE-4150: "year-end payout request" and attached the BambooHR approval screenshot.
People Ops Bot: CE-4150 received. Note: because this is >8h carryover, People Ops review required. Reviewing now.
Payroll Bot: CE-4150 acknowledged. Please ensure final confirmation before cutoff 2026-01-04 23:59 PST. If paperwork complete, payout will be included in the next payroll run.
Olivia: Quick FYI 1: non-medical exceptions are discretionary. If you'd prefer splitting (4h payout + 4h carryover) we can do that; file CE accordingly. Also logging DOC-3560 to clarify policy wording about carryover + payout combos.
Jo: No split needed, payout is fine. Thanks all.
Sam: Noted. Enjoy the extra cash :)
People Ops Bot: Thread status: awaiting payroll finalization for CE-4150. Will post confirmation here when processed.
